It explicitly mentions experiments on three benchmark datasets (FinQA, ConvFinQA, TAT-QA), reports accuracy results, and includes ablation studies and cross-backbone evaluations. The method involves retrieval (via a "Contrastive Financial Retriever") and generation (via a "Program-of-Thought reasoning module") where the generator conditions on retrieved documents—fitting the definition of RAG. The paper proposes and evaluates a new RAG method with empirical results, meeting the inclusion criterion.

There is no indication it is a survey, review, or tutorial (not E2), it is clearly about RAG (not E1), and it focuses on text-based financial documents, not multimodal-only RAG (not E9). Therefore, the decision is INCLUDE.
